limitations: Tests exercise manually traced controlled image fixtures; no automatic or physical-photo recognition rate is measured.
These existing scripts inspect gradeable data but do not perform real Save & Grade and refresh restoration.
The installed runtime emits font decoding warnings; existing regression listeners record no application console errors.
Initial browser test attempts were blocked by sandbox npm cache writes; reported results come from the successful elevated rerun.
